source_row.rationale: Teriparatide, a parathyroid hormone analog, works by stimulating new bone formation, making it an anabolic (bone-building) agent, distinct from the primarily antiresorptive (bone breakdown-reducing) mechanism of bisphosphonates, offering an alternative approach for severe osteoporosis.
